text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O crosses the line now!
She falls to her sworn rival, Admire Vega!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, what a turn of events! To have pushed my nemesis
to give her all, only to be struck down myself!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, falling in tragedy makes me equally beautiful!
Wouldn't you agree, Trainer-kun?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: When I say "fall," it's just in the play, though! I really have no intention of falling at all, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O is not the kind of person to be discouraged by something like this. Of course, I already knew that.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Ayabe-san!
That was an unrecognizable run, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
We may have lost, but thanks to that, it turned into a fantastic performance.
What happened out there?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Because... you were the one who told me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Face the troubles within yourself"...
He said that after the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So today, I was able to focus entirely on my own running.
And doing that brought the results with it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
With this, I know I can bear it.
—My destiny.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's how it was...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
As expected of me. Even the casual words
I utter in daily life serve to enlighten people.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Ayabe-san? When I first cast
you as my rival, you weren't too keen, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Once you tried it, weren't you quite satisfied just basking in the afterglow of my spotlight?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah.
I suppose you could put it that way."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course you can! In fact, hold your head high and shout for joy.
Shout that happiness has found you!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san... is incredible...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
To make Ayabe-san, who was so reluctant...
smile like that...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Howevvver! This is merely the prologue.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Chapter 1, the spring of the Classic year comes to an end,
and now—the main chapter begins!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Because from here on, we'll be able to
enter Senior Class races too.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
How about it, Ayabe-san?
Now that you're settled into your role as my rival,
shall we challenge the older generation together?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes, the race to aim for is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: It's the year-end Arima Kinen! Why don't we ring the bell for a generational shift together there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No sooner had the Derby ended
than T.M. Opera O
set off her next big display of fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The "Arima Kinen"...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'll... pass.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, well? What is the matter?
This isn't like you. What is the reason?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
One reason is... I'm still not good enough.
I don't have the strength to beat those at the top...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And the other thing is—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Keeping up with your vibe...
is exhausting... Doing it non-stop... is way too rough...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Haaah...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, Ayabe-san?!
Don't say that! Don't give up!
Once you get used to it, it's actually pretty addicting, you know?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come back, Ayabe-san!
Dive right into my chest! Hoooey!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Blushing bright red, Admire Vega
walked away briskly. It seems she
couldn't bear the embarrassment.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, an excessive amount of shyness
can certainly be troublesome.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Well, fine.
I'm sure they'll get used to it in time."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And so, having brought her Spring Classic campaign to a close, T.M. Opera O grew even stronger as she charged forward toward the year-end Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Auuugh... Opera O-san's rival...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: What if, back then...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, my worthy rival Doto.
My impromptu villain!
Take my hand! Come, come!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: If only I had taken that outstretched hand back then, right now, I...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Auuugh... Auuuugh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I want to... become stronger...
Even more... someday, even stronger..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
So that I can live up
to Opera O-san's expectations...!
